name: campus-insight
description: 校园行迹：以调查问卷为核心，地图小游戏行动带出可核对的问卷建议，最终十题统一生成个人解读与图表，支持成员确认提交和圈子汇总。

scripts.build: node scripts/build-campus-web.mjs && node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.smoke: vite build --configLoader runner --ssr scripts/smoke-render.jsx --outDir .smoke-out --logLevel warn && node .smoke-out/smoke-render.js
scripts.check: npm run selftest && npm run selftest:store && npm run selftest:map && npm run selftest:intro && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:csv && npm run build && npm run verify:dist && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:stats && npm run test:ai && npm run test:relay && npm run test:explanation && npm run test:csv && npm run test:export && npm run test:experience && npm run test:answers && npm run test:motion && npm run test:journey && npm run test:3d && npm run test:walk && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:accounts && npm run test:deployment && npm run test:windows && npm run test:navigation && npm run test:guidance && npm run test:registration && npm run test:play && npm run test:parkour && npm run test:participation && npm run test:field && npm run test:report-core && npm run test:day-survey
scripts.gen:cohort: python scripts/generate-survey-data.py -n 48 --seed 20261001 --out public/data/示例-班级问卷.csv
scripts.test:field: node scripts/test-industrial-journey.mjs && node scripts/test-companion-position.mjs && node scripts/test-campus-story.mjs && node scripts/test-story-atmosphere.mjs && node scripts/test-story-library.mjs && node scripts/test-campus-day.mjs && node scripts/test-campus-paths.mjs
